correctness.rationale: For Černý C_{2m} with r:i→i+1 and d:0→1, each rank drop requires an effective d and at least two r between consecutive effective drops, giving baseline s+2(s−1)=3m+1 at s=m+1. If a word had ≤3m+2 letters, after trimming redundant ends either all d are effective with total n or n+1 rotations (cumulative hole differences wrap to 0 or 1 modulo n and forbid effectiveness), or exactly one d is ineffective and only n rotations (forced two-r gaps; the ineffective letter is deletable or prevents following effective d). Thus additional two letters necessary. Explicit d r³ d (r²d)^{m−2} r³d has all m+1 effective steps; cumulative shifts 0,3,5,...,n−1,n+2 avoid forbidden differences 0,1 mod n. Independent BFS on image subsets confirms λ_{2m}(m+1)=12,15,18,21,24,27,30 for n=6,8,...,18. The finite checks corroborate proof, not unbounded n. No s>m+1 claim.
